title: Social Studies / EVS Society — CBSE Grade 2

sections.title: My Family
sections.explanation: A family lives together and cares for one another. Some families are small; some are joint with grandparents and uncles. Love, sharing chores and speaking kindly keep a family happy. Indian homes often celebrate festivals together.
points: Parents, siblings and grandparents are family
Help with small chores: packing bag, watering plants
Celebrate birthdays and festivals together
Listen to elders and share your day at dinner

examples.problem: Who often helps you get ready for school?

steps: Keep toys tidy or fill water bottle

sections.title: My Neighbourhood
sections.explanation: A neighbourhood is the area around our home. It has houses, shops, parks, places of worship and helpful people. Keeping lanes clean and greeting neighbours politely makes the area friendly and safe.
points: Neighbours live near us — be friendly
Places: market, park, temple/mosque/church/gurdwara, clinic
Do not litter; use dustbins
Avoid loud noise late at night

steps: Carry a light bag or greet and ask if they need help

sections.title: Our School
sections.explanation: School is where we learn reading, writing, maths and good habits. We make friends and respect teachers. Being on time, wearing neat uniform and listening in class are important Grade 2 duties.
points: Classroom, library, playground, assembly ground
Teacher, principal, classmates, peon/helpers
Be on time; complete homework
Share and wait for your turn in games

sections.title: People Who Help Us
sections.explanation: Community helpers keep our life safe and comfortable. Doctors treat us, teachers teach us, farmers grow food and cleaners keep streets tidy. We should thank them and never mock their work.
points: Doctor, nurse, teacher
Police officer, firefighter
Postman/courier, farmer, sanitation workers
Driver, tailor, carpenter, shopkeeper

sections.title: Village and City
sections.explanation: Villages often have open fields, fewer tall buildings and many farmers. Cities have more vehicles, tall buildings, markets and offices. Both need clean water, schools and caring people. Many Indian families have roots in both.
points: Village: farms, quieter roads, closer nature
City: buses, metros, big markets, apartments
Both need helpers, schools and hospitals
Respect people wherever they live

sections.title: Occupations (Jobs People Do)
sections.explanation: An occupation is the work people do to earn a living and help society. Different jobs need different skills. When we grow up we may choose work we love while helping others.
points: Teacher teaches; doctor treats patients
Pilot flies planes; chef cooks food
Potter makes pots; weaver makes cloth
All honest work deserves respect

examples.title: Match
examples.problem: Who stitches clothes?

examples.title: Market
examples.problem: Who sells vegetables in the sabzi mandi?

sections.title: Our Earth — Land and Water
sections.explanation: Earth is our home. It has land (soil, mountains, plains) and water (rivers, lakes, seas). We must not waste water or dirty rivers. Plants, animals and people share this planet.
points: Land: hills, plains, deserts, forests (simple names)
Water: river, pond, lake, sea, rain
Save water: close taps; do not waste
Do not throw plastic into drains or rivers

sections.title: India — National Symbols (Intro)
sections.explanation: National symbols help us feel proud of India. Grade 2 children learn a few famous ones: the Tiranga (flag), the tiger, the peacock and the lotus. We respect the flag and sing the national anthem with attention.
points: National flag: Tiranga — saffron, white, green with Ashoka Chakra
National animal: Tiger
National bird: Peacock
National flower: Lotus (light intro)

sections.title: Independence Day & Republic Day
sections.explanation: Independence Day (15 August) celebrates freedom from British rule. Republic Day (26 January) celebrates our Constitution — the big book of rules for the country. Schools hold flag hoisting and marches. We remember brave leaders and stay united.
points: 15 August — Independence Day
26 January — Republic Day
Flag hoisting, patriotic songs, respect silence
Meaning for kids: freedom, fairness and togetherness

sections.title: Traffic Rules (Deeper)
sections.explanation: Roads are busy in Indian cities and towns. Traffic rules keep us safe. Always use the zebra crossing with an adult, look both ways and never play on the road. Learn signal colours and simple road signs.
points: Red = stop · Yellow = wait · Green = go carefully
Use footpath; hold an adult’s hand
Zebra crossing for walking across
Wear helmet on two-wheelers; seat belt in cars when available

sections.title: Public Places
sections.explanation: Public places are shared by everyone. Parks, post offices, hospitals, railway stations and libraries help the community. We keep them clean, speak softly and follow queue rules.
points: Park: play safely; do not pluck plants
Post office: send letters and parcels
Hospital: place for treatment — stay quiet and kind
Station/bus stand: stay with elders; do not wander

sections.title: Festivals and Travel
sections.explanation: India celebrates many festivals with lights, sweets and family visits. Travel by bus, train or car needs planning and safety. Carry water, stay with adults and be polite to fellow passengers.
points: Festivals bring joy — share sweets; avoid waste and firecrackers harm
Greet relatives; help decorate safely
Travel: ticket, seat, no running near tracks
Thank drivers and helpers on the journey

examples.answer: Stay with adults / behind safety line

examples.title: Festival
examples.problem: Why do families gather on festival days?
steps: To share joy, food and traditions

sections.title: Good Citizen Habits
sections.explanation: A good citizen follows rules, helps others and cares for public property. Even Grade 2 children can queue patiently, speak truth and keep surroundings clean. Small good acts make India stronger.
points: Stand in queue; do not push
Tell the truth; return lost things
Save electricity and water at home
Respect the national flag and anthem
